image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a cooked meatloaf on a metallic baking tray. The loaf has been sliced, revealing a textured interior with visible ground meat, breadcrumbs, and vegetable flecks (likely carrots or onions). The exterior is coated in a thick, glossy, reddish-brown glaze, likely ketchup or tomato-based. The lighting is somewhat harsh, creating specular highlights on the glaze.

The boundary between the loaf and the tray is slightly soft and indistinct, with some 'smearing' of the meat texture into the background, suggesting minor generation instability or compression artifacts.
The metal tray edges show slight warping and inconsistent reflectivity, common in AI-generated backgrounds.
